verifiedAgainst.title: SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Creating a new pattern (TR-REC)

text.ru: В TR-REC ([PATTERN SELECT] → [REC] → пэд → [REMAIN] → [REC]) найди параметр SHUFFLE на [CTRL 3].
text.en: In TR-REC ([PATTERN SELECT] → [REC] → a pad → [REMAIN] → [REC]) find SHUFFLE on [CTRL 3].

text.ru: Значения −50…+50: 0 — без шаффла, около +10…+16 — приятный шаффл.
text.en: Values run −50…+50: 0 is no shuffle, around +10…+16 is a pleasant shuffle.

tryIt.ru: Запиши хэты с SHUFFLE +12 и сравни с 0.
tryIt.en: Record hats with SHUFFLE +12 and compare with 0.
